possible_explanations.statement: Supply tightness in SA1 (reduced local available generation or elevated clearing prices through the window) might have contributed to the high prices; check unit outage and generation-change records for the peak interval 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z (interval end) and surrounding intervals [c1].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare unit-level generation change and outage reports at and around 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z and the five-minute dispatch RRP series (ev0437).

possible_explanations.statement: Limited interconnector capability or interconnector constraint notices (for example the Tailem_Bnd to South_East line notice [c2]) could be relevant to the event and might have affected imports; this could be tested by reviewing interconnector constraint equations and interchange around 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine interconnector constraint bindings and net interchange time series at 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z (ev0439) and compare with the constraint notice text [c2].

possible_explanations.statement: Elevated demand in the dispatch sense (dispatch TOTALDEMAND, 5-minute) around the peak might have been a factor; this could be tested by comparing dispatch TOTALDEMAND at 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z with unit dispatch and half-hour operational demand.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare dispatch TOTALDEMAND at 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z (ev0438) with half-hour operational demand for half-hour end 2026-07-30T17:00:00Z (ev0915) and unit dispatch outputs.
